title: Founding Sales Lead
description:
Incresco is a profitable technology company. We’re building a new product for hotels, and this is its first commercial hire. We’re keeping the product under wraps for now. You’ll hear all about it when we meet.

**The job:**
you own Karnataka and the South, starting in Bangalore. We hand you a researched, ranked list of hotels, lodges and stays, with owner contacts where we have them. Opening the doors is yours, and most of it is cold and in person. You get meetings with owners and GMs, work out where each property is losing guest revenue, show them, then demo, close, and stay involved until the property is live and the team is using it.

**We’re a lean team and we move fast**

You’ll be out at properties most days, covering a lot of ground, and the work won’t wait for a long ramp-up. If you like building a territory from nothing and being measured on what you get done, you’ll like this.

**Also useful**

* 3–6 years in sales, with deals you can walk through one by one
* A background in hospitality (hotel sales, or selling services or software into hotels, lodges or independent stays), or a strong cold-selling record in a nearby field
* A good grasp of how a property makes money: occupancy, ADR, ancillary revenue, OTA commissions
* English plus Kannada, Tamil or Hindi
* Based in Bangalore and happy to travel across the South as the territory grows

**You’ll recognise yourself if you’ve done this**

* **You’ve won an account that had no reason to switch.**
  You got in the door cold, found something the buyer hadn’t noticed, and built the case from nothing until they changed their mind. You can tell that story in detail.
* **You can walk into a property and see where it loses money.**
  You can look at a hotel or lodge and say where it leaks revenue from the guests already staying there, and put the case to the owner.
* **You’ve handled the owner who says “I’ve run this fine for 20 years.”**
  You know what to say to someone who sees no reason to change anything, and you don’t back off.
* **You know your own numbers.**
  In a typical week of cold outreach you can say how many properties you visit, how many meetings that gets you, and how many become deals.

If you can say yes to most of these, apply. When we speak, we’ll ask you to tell us the story behind each one.

**What you get**

* A direct line to the founders. Decisions take hours.
* The chance to build the function from zero.
* Fixed pay plus commission on properties that sign and go live.

**Platform ownership**

* Experience running platform operations: monitoring and alerting, incident management, runbooks, capacity and performance management.
* Experience with Databricks cost management and FinOps practices.
* Platform security and compliance experience: identity, service principals, secrets, network controls, audit logging, RBAC and PII handling, with an understanding of controls such as SOX.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems and system design for large-scale data processing.

title: GTM Engineer (Fresh grad, India)
description:
**Location**
: 100% Remote from India, min. 4h overlap with CET (e.g. 9:00–13:00 CET). Fluent English, spoken and written. German is not required.
  
  
**Compensation**
: 20k-32k USD per year (depending on location) + Shares + Generous Benefits. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.
  
  
**About Secfix**
Secfix automates security compliance for SMBs and mid-market companies in Europe and gets them compliant with ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX and SOC 2 in weeks instead of months. We’re a fast-growing team of 36 people, backed by a $12M Series A from Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank) and Bayern Capital.
  
  
**About The Role**
You’ll be our first GTM Engineer and build the system our entire go-to-market team runs on, from BDRs to AEs. Today, everyone runs their own setup for data, outreach and communication. You’ll replace that with one central, automated system and keep it reliable as we grow. This is a hands-on engineering role: you’ll write code (Python, SQL) every day, connect APIs and build data pipelines and AI workflows, not configure tools or run RevOps. You report to our Head of GTM, talk to everyone in GTM, spot the biggest bottlenecks and decide together what to build next. We own products and outcomes, not Jira tickets.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Data: Make our CRM the single source of truth for every target account. Model accounts, contacts and buying committees, and build automated pipelines that pull data from multiple sources, deduplicate, score and write it back.
* Pipeline generation: Build signal-based outbound, inbound scoring and routing, and alerts that tell the right rep which account to call today and why.
* Sales automation: Build AI tools and agents that take repetitive work off our AEs, from research to proposals to CRM updates.
* GTM infrastructure: Design our central data layer, integrate new tools via APIs and webhooks, and make sure everything runs reliably: scheduled jobs, error handling, monitoring and alerts when something breaks.
* Ownership end-to-end: Investigate problems, find the root cause, ship the fix and document it so nothing depends on one person.

Your success: reps spend less time on manual work and more time with customers, and more pipeline comes from systems that run reliably and are actually used.
  
  
**About You**
You’re an engineer who loves building things real people use every day, and are curious about the business. You build systems that run reliably at 10x volume, not one-off scripts.
  
  

* Recent graduate (0–2 years) in Computer Science or another engineering field with a strong academic record.
* 1+ years of experience through your first full-time job or internships in a startup environment.
* Solid Python and hands-on experience with APIs and webhooks.
* You know how to run code in production: version control (Git), scheduling, handling errors and rate limits, logging and debugging.
* You think in systems: you understand how components depend on each other and what breaks when you change one part.
* Smart, structured problem solver and fast learner: you pick up new tools and technologies on your own and bring complexity down.
* Hands-on experience with Claude (incl. Claude Code or the API). This is a must-have.
* You’ve built and shipped real things (an automation, scraper, data pipeline or internal tool) and can show them.
* Independent, proactive and comfortable communicating remotely, especially in writing.

**Nice to have:**
SQL and data modeling, experience with a CRM, GTM tools like Clay, a data warehouse or a cloud platform.
  
  
You
**should not apply**
if:
  
  

* You need detailed tickets telling you what to build.
* You only want to write code and don’t care about business impact.
* You don’t want to test, monitor and maintain what you ship.
* You’d rather be led than lead your own projects.
* You don’t want to work closely with Sales and the people who use your tools.

**Interview Process**

* ~30 min – Introductory call with our Talent team
* Technical take-home challenge (~8–10h, 7 days to submit)
* ~90 min – Interview incl. live coding with our Head of GTM
* Final interview with our co-founder and Head of GTM

**What we offer**

* Remote Work: 100% remote work with a virtual office in Gather.
* Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.
* Equity: Generous equity package – we’re all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success.
* Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays.
* Health Insurance: Comprehensive health coverage.
* Development Budget: €1,000 annual personal development budget.
* Workspace Budget: Remote workspace budget and access to co-working spaces.
* Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (this year we’re headed to Alicante, Spain!).
* Tech Equipment: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, monitors, headphones).
* Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun!
* Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors.

Our values: we are obsessed with our customers, we build smart, we create trust, we are hacky, we take ownership, and we are leaders of remote.

Minimum

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
Senior Platform Engineer
  
  
**Job Description**
**So, who are we?**
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
  
  
  
  
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
  
  
Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
  
  
**Your team**
This role is part of our Platform Engineering team who are responsible for building the cloud and containers platform landscape to support the business applications via self-service capabilities and automation.
  
  
**Your role in the Team's Success**
As a Senior Platform Engineer, you’ll be a hands-on technical expert who builds, improves and operates platform infrastructure that is secure, scalable, reliable and cost-effective, across our on-premises and AWS estates.
  
  
You’ll bring engineering, security and FinOps best practice into platform design and delivery. You’ll contribute to complex technical decisions, reduce platform risk, and help engineering teams deliver with confidence and speed. You’ll also mentor more junior engineers and promote knowledge sharing across the team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and build scalable, secure AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and contribute to cloud technology evaluation and standardisation.
* Build and maintain configuration management using open-source Puppet (roles, profiles and modules with Hiera), developing reusable modules with unit testing, linting, versioning and controlled promotion across environments. Use Ansible for orchestration and automation tasks where it is the better fit.
* Design, build and optimise GitLab CI/CD pipelines that test, validate and deploy infrastructure and configuration changes, embedding DevOps and DevSecOps practices such as secrets management and vulnerability scanning.
* Manage and automate AWS EC2 and Linux estates with AWS Systems Manager (State Manager, Run Command, Patch Manager, Parameter Store and automation documents), including instance configuration, hardening and lifecycle management.
* Manage the certificate lifecycle across platform services, including issuance, renewal, rotation and expiry monitoring, and automate these processes to reduce outages and manual effort.
* Build and run Kubernetes environments (EKS) and deliver self-service capabilities to development teams through platform tooling and an internal developer platform (for example Backstage).
* Lead infrastructure modernisation, including OS migrations, tooling upgrades and reducing configuration drift across environments.
* Manage the software and dependency lifecycle, including security patching, vulnerability management, open-source component updates and RPM package management, with a clear inventory of platform dependencies.
* Maintain organised, versioned and accessible artefacts and packages through repository tooling such as JFrog Artifactory.
* Define and apply monitoring, alerting and observability standards (for example Honeycomb, Prometheus and Grafana) so issues are found and understood before they affect users.
* Act as subject-matter expert in diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure and configuration incidents, running root cause analysis and putting preventive measures in place.
* Partner with Platform Managers and development teams to understand their needs and deliver solutions that work, helping to bridge development and operations.
* Mentor junior engineers and write and maintain clear documentation to support continuous learning and engineering best practice.

**Key Qualification Requirements**
**What you'll need for this role**

* Experience level: 6+ years in infrastructure engineering, configuration management and automation, including significant hands-on experience with Linux systems and AWS cloud.

**Core Technical Requirements**




+ Configuration management: Strong hands-on expertise with open-source Puppet, including writing, testing and maintaining modules using roles, profiles and Hiera. Experience with module testing and release workflows (for example rspec-puppet and puppet-lint) is essential. Working experience with Ansible (playbooks, roles and inventory management) is also required.
+ Certificate management and rotation: Hands-on experience managing the certificate lifecycle, including issuance, renewal, rotation and expiry monitoring, using internal or public certificate authorities and tooling such as AWS Certificate Manager. Ability to automate rotation safely across Linux, load balancer and Kubernetes environments.
+ AWS cloud: Solid hands-on experience designing and operating AWS platforms, especially EC2, with a good understanding of IAM, S3, VPC and networking (for example Transit Gateway and Direct Connect).
+ AWS Systems Manager: Practical experience using SSM for configuration and state management (State Manager, Run Command, Patch Manager, Parameter Store and automation documents).
+ Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience with Terraform. Terragrunt or equivalent tooling is a plus.
+ CI/CD and DevSecOps: Experience designing multi-stage CI/CD pipelines, ideally in GitLab (or Jenkins or GitHub Actions), with good knowledge of security practice such as secrets management, vulnerability scanning and compliance.
+ Linux administration: Strong experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9, Rocky Linux 9 or equivalent, including systemd, SELinux and security hardening.
+ Scripting: Strong Python and Bash skills for automation. Go is a plus.
+ Packaging and artefacts: RPM package management and building, with experience administering RPM repositories and artefact repositories such as Artifactory or Nexus.
+ Containers and Kubernetes: Working experience administering Kubernetes (EKS preferred), including networking, RBAC, pod security and Docker image management. Service mesh (Istio) is a plus.
+ Observability and reliability: Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools (Honeycomb, Prometheus and Grafana) and defining alerting standards.
+ Networking and architecture: Strong network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, traffic management and troubleshooting) and a good grasp of microservices and cloud architecture patterns.
+ Software lifecycle and security: Experience managing security patching, vulnerability management and dependency hygiene. Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS is advantageous.
+ Version control and collaboration: Proficient with Git (GitLab, GitHub and Bitbucket), able to work autonomously and contribute to engineering standards across teams.

**The Perks**
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
  
  

* Performance-related bonus
* Life insurance
* Medical insurance for you and your family
* Provident fund contributions from day one
* Employee assistance programme
* Contribution to gym memberships
* Lunch & snacks on us
* 15 days annual leave increasing to 20 days after 2 years’ continuous service
* A day off to celebrate your birthday as well as two days’ volunteering leave per year.

**Join us for this exciting journey. Apply now!**
